cadence: saturating count of legitimate selected-history write callbacks including speculative update, correction, rollback and actual recovery refill; inspect at first prediction-read boundary after k writes, never peek at injector/golden state
write_policy: retain prior per-word parity residual through legitimate writes using p_new=p_old XOR parity(data_old) XOR parity(data_new); no unchecked re-encoding laundering. Two additional parity/update data observations are accounted, not declared free hardware
counter_storage: 8 logical inspection_progress bits exposed in manifest and correctness tests; interval is a synthesis/config constant
atomic_update_scratch: 23 before-write parity residuals are transient within atomic software callback; serialized RTL scratch/ports must be included in future cost; shared combinational SET excluded
cpp_split: existing E1 design only; original holdout files unmodified
selection_rule: among finite candidate k choose minimum balanced exploratory proxy: equal two-workload weighting and equal single/repeat-family weighting, proxy=20*net_extra_misses+1*inspection_checks; ties choose smaller k. Uses only CPP design seeds; proxy is NOT gem5 CPU cycles or measured optimal policy
cpu_baseline_reuse: audited existing namespace-v2 latency same program/trial seed and schedule: P0 ideal plus P_ED/P_ECC/P_TMR C1/R4; existing main same-field/single seeds for P0 single causal tail comparator. No unchanged baseline reruns
cpu_eval_seed_split: all owners disjoint from cpp design125480000; existing baseline evaluation outcomes are already known, no claim of new workload-blind population
cpu_exposure: same selected346 payload sites; all parity/controller/progress storage excluded from targeted statistical pilot, separately exposed by correctness gates; this is not full-population qualification
cpu_timing: C charged only on due periodic prediction read; write residual propagation on independent update lane, modeled added response latency0, actual workload/sidecar operations counted; all detection repair batches serialize R on response port; arrivals continue during holds; NOT measured RTL timing
cpu_model_stop: 4x pristine duration, same existing schedules; normal exit future events right-censored; asserts/timeout/syscall/native output/model stop are failures
resource_authority: user no server limits; two-trial engineering gate first, then fixed pilot budget
statistics: matched seed within each fixed program; bootstrap2000 equal program weighting; A=P0clean B=P0fault C=ownclean D=ownfault, raw net B-D and normalized pp; single-event detection delay and net/harm/tail quantiles with explicit sample counts/censoring; no inferential quantile guarantees from5seed pilots
rate_status: declared source-informed software stress; no physical per-bit/s conversion
novelty_status: periodic checking/scrubbing and parity are prior art; TAGE history-update residual preservation, speculative schedule and cost/tail findings are research questions, not preclaimed novelty
